name: @gto/report-view
description: Host-agnostic HTML rendering for a GTO AnalysisReport — the single source of truth for what a review result LOOKS like (issue cards, fix diffs, QA skeletons, diagrams, styling), shared between the VS Code extension and the IntelliJ plugin. Deliberately excludes host interactivity (postMessage/JCEF bridge wiring, button click handlers) — see README.md.
